Finding: 34 critical vulnerabilities on internet-facing assets exceed the defined remediation SLA; oldest is 118 days.
Remediation Action: Clear backlog; implement automated escalation at 75% of SLA elapsed

Finding: Backup restoration has not been tested since 2024. Restore capability is unverified for all 9 critical services.
Remediation Action: Perform full restore test for each critical service; establish quarterly cycle

Finding: MFA is registered by 71% of users and enforced by policy for 0%. Service accounts and contractors excluded entirely.
Remediation Action: Deploy Conditional Access in report-only then enforce; remediate 4 dependent service accounts

Finding: 68 privileged directory role assignments are permanent and standing, including 12 Global Administrators.
Remediation Action: Convert to eligible assignments with approval, MFA on activation and 4-hour maximum

Finding: 340 workload identities exist with no owner recorded; 6 hold broad directory permissions granted during a 2025 pilot and never reviewed.
Remediation Action: Inventory with named owner and justification; revoke unused permissions to least privilege

Finding: Regular traffic to consumer AI services observed from Finance and Sales endpoints. No technical control; no record of data submitted.
Remediation Action: Block unapproved AI services at egress; provide sanctioned alternative; monitor attempts

Finding: No AI system in production has a documented authority boundary or named owner.
Remediation Action: Mandatory registration; block deployment without owner and boundary

Finding: EDR is deployed to 82% of corporate endpoints. The 18% gap is concentrated in plant-adjacent devices.
Remediation Action: Complete deployment; establish coverage KPI with monthly reporting

Finding: IT and OT networks are not segmented at the two largest plants, permitting lateral movement from corporate to plant systems.
Remediation Action: Segmentation requires capital investment; deferred to FY27. Compensating: EDR completion and monitoring.

Finding: Cloud configuration is not assessed against any defined baseline. No compliance scanning in place.
Remediation Action: Deploy continuous configuration compliance scanning with auto-remediation for high-severity drift

Finding: Data retention policy is published but not technically enforced. No data inventory exists to apply it to.
Remediation Action: Build data inventory; apply technical retention enforcement to identified personal data stores

Finding: Region restrictions are applied to 2 of 5 major platforms. Regulated data may reside outside approved jurisdictions on 3 platforms.
Remediation Action: Extend region restrictions to remaining 3 platforms

Finding: Supplier due diligence is performed at onboarding only. No reassessment cycle exists. Subcontractors are unmapped for all 11 critical suppliers.
Remediation Action: Establish annual reassessment; map subcontractors; add 24-hour incident notification to contracts

Finding: No contingency or exit plan exists for any critical technology supplier.
Remediation Action: Document manual fallback for order processing; exit plan per critical supplier; test annually

Finding: 11 unauthorised production changes detected in a 90-day sample. Standard changes are not monitored.
Remediation Action: Extend change control to standard changes; alert on out-of-process change

Finding: 14 end-of-life systems in production with no remediation plan. Lifecycle tracking covers servers only.
Remediation Action: Extend lifecycle tracking beyond servers; remediation plan per EOL system

Finding: RTO is documented for 4 of 9 critical services. End-to-end recovery has never been tested.
Remediation Action: Define RTO for all critical services; annual end-to-end recovery test

Finding: Regulatory notification triggers are not embedded in the incident management process. Assessment depends on individual judgement.
Remediation Action: Embed notification triggers and statutory timers into incident workflow

Finding: No central repository of control evidence. Customer security questionnaires are answered ad hoc with no supporting evidence retained.
Remediation Action: Establish control evidence repository maintained by second line

Finding: No segregation of duties conflict detection in finance. 23 pre-existing conflicts identified during assessment, 6 with no alternative role holder.
Remediation Action: Define SoD conflict matrix; quarterly detective reporting; role redesign for the 6 blocked conflicts deferred to FY27
